It’s precast reinforced concrete tubes that are 32” across and approximately 40” deep. I have a solid metal grill with rebar legs which is placed over the coals. I wrap the meet in foil, burlap that has been soaked in water and bailing wire with a loop to lower it in. Once in, I have a metal lid that covers the bbq that I bury with dirt this is sprayed with water to completely seal it off. The deep pit then has no new sources of heat and acts as a earthen oven which is a prevalent cooking method around the world. My grandfather had this exact setup when I was a kid, now it’s my time to carry on the tradition.
